notes:
Dahu 0.110.1 beta for Windows.

- Rhino preselection flow: Loft, Sweep, Sweep2, NetworkSrf, Patch, FilletSrf and Contour started on selected objects wait at their options with the live preview; Enter applies, Esc cancels without changes. Commands without options still run at once.
- Remembered tool options: each command keeps its last-used option values, also after restarting Dahu (lengths stay exact in any document unit).
- Live previews: Loft, Sweep, Sweep2, NetworkSrf and Patch open their options with the preview and apply on the second Enter, like Rhino's dialog and OK; ArrayLinear previews live. The separate Preview option is gone where the preview is automatic.
- Options cleanup: options Rhino does not have are removed from the option bar, rarely used ones move to a collapsed Advanced group (still typeable), some names follow Rhino (e.g. Loft Style=Normal/Straight). Remembered values are migrated.
- Typed dimensions: Rectangle and Box show the typed value (Width=80 mm) and keep it locked in the preview and the next pick; a length typed at the opposite-corner prompt sets Width, then Depth. Ellipse Radius1 and the new Polygon Radius=/Diameter=/Length= options fix the size while the pointer picks the direction (click or Enter places). Free, or Width= left empty, releases the lock without leaving the command.
- FilletEdge/ChamferEdge: a second fillet or chamfer next to an earlier one now finishes only the picked edges instead of spreading over the earlier finish.
- OffsetCrv: choosing Side highlights that offset and Enter applies it; the preview shows one solid offset on the cursor side, as in Rhino. OffsetSrf: a typed Distance updates the preview, Enter applies.
- New logo with a central fold on the pictogram; the startup splash screen shows it too.

Unsigned: on first install choose More info > Run anyway.
